count_definition: PREREG section 2.3: for each candidate night t in the window, computed at 16:05 ET before any forward bar is read: (1) drop the night entirely if it appears in exclusions_v003.json unioned with the add-only successor exclusions file (manual_runs union non_session_runs union uncorroborated_publication_runs), or if sas_runs.finished_at is later than the next session open (DP-04); (2) require k_t >= 1 after section 2.4 pick-level screens (no swing-lane target; outcome_target_invalid non-null or swing T1 on the wrong side of C_t; the price-scale screen target/C_t outside [0.5,2.0] or implied ATR distance above 12 ATR; fewer than 60 daily bars <= t or no C_t or no session t+1 open; not gradeable); (3) require the registered benchmark arm in question to be computable on that night (SPY/RSP bars for t and t+1; a candidate pool of at least k_t non-published rows with >= 60 prior daily bars for the rank arms; a mapped sector for at least one pick with at least one same-sector unpublished candidate for the sector arm) -- a night on which an arm is not computable is non-contributing for that arm only, never an exclusion; (4) require the night to be MATURED: session t+20 on or before the last trading date of the pinned price freeze -- immature nights are excluded and counted, never graded as a non-touch; (5) CONTRIBUTING NIGHT (the floor unit, DP-21): a night surviving 1-4 for the arm in question, carrying >= 1 gradeable pick.
